name: theme-mode-order
description: The client projection of the themeMode total order. Promoted from iframe-runtime's host-theme-mode pin (ggui#589) and protocol's theme-binding pin: with a stamped mode and a host announce present, the STAMP wins — the announce is the final fallback. This case is the ggui#987 arbiter receipt (VERSION-POLICY §1.1): it passes at N and fails when the order flips.
